plan.title: Control-plane consolidation (bounded contexts, contracts, single-owner guards)
plan.goal: One owner per decision, enforced on the existing system-state-authorities registry and checker; adopt-vs-build on explicit criteria with sunsets
success_criteria: Each of the nine multi-owner decisions maps to one owner in one of five contexts (K1-K5) and nine aggregates (A1-A9)
A new non-owner mutation of an owned decision fails tier0 or its runtime control, with a negative test
No component is replaced without retiring the old one; every spike has a sunset
